headline: Debabrata Das appointed as new CFO of HOEC
hook: Leadership change at Hindustan Oil Exploration
summary: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company (HOEC) has appointed Debabrata Das as its new Chief Financial Officer. This follows the resignation of the former CFO, who stepped down citing personal reasons. The transition in the finance leadership role is effective immediately. Retail investors should note that management stability is a key factor in evaluating operational execution for oil and gas exploration firms.
why_it_matters: Management continuity is vital for project execution in the energy sector.

headline: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company announces board meeting outcome
hook: Routine board meeting update from Hindustan Oil
summary: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company Limited has released the outcome of its board meeting held on October 13, 2026. The company submitted the formal details to the stock exchanges as part of its regular compliance reporting. Retail investors should review the specific filing details for any material corporate actions or operational updates.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate stock impact
